column5: Are the ergative and the genitive expressed by the same marker?
column8: The marking for the ergative and genitive cases are different. The marking for the genitive case in this language is the enclitic =ko, while for the ergative case it is the enclitic =i.

column5: Are the ergative and the instrumental/comitative expressed by the same marker?
column8: The same ergative marker is used for the instrumental (=i) but not for the comitative (=kusi), according to Table 112.
